spec_match.rationale: Builds the exact joinGroup()/MulticastGroupOptions calls from the spec (ASM string vs SSM dictionary), models the spec's source filtering faithfully, shows the joinedGroups union shape (DOMString vs MulticastMembership), and flags the IANA 232/8 convention as recommended-not-enforced, as the explainer does.

interactive.rationale: Membership mode radios, SSM source select, three sender toggles, three scenario presets and a send button all drive the generated code, the SVG diagram, a per-sender ledger, an event log, and the joinedGroups readout.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card promises an interactive diagram with toggleable sources and a model label; delivered, with the MODEL tag repeated on-page.

edge_cases.rationale: The attacker preset shows ASM's injection weakness and SSM's filter flip on identical senders; the discovery preset honestly shows where ASM remains the right tool (mDNS on-link); the no-senders case is handled.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/6208452397498368, the sourceAddress spec anchor, and the explainer's use-case/receiving sections.

conformance.rationale: The suite asserts the exact joinGroup/leaveGroup/joinedGroups surface this lab teaches, plus the manual real-network assertion; verified executing on /conformance/ (1/6/1 on Chromium 141).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Playwright-driven headless Chromium 141: attack preset under ASM delivered the attacker's datagram (2/2 delivered), switching to SSM filtered it (ledger: attacker 1 delivered from the ASM round, 1 filtered from the SSM round); event log, receiver count, diagram outcome markers and joinedGroups shape all updated; honesty banner reports typeof UDPSocket 'undefined' live; zero console errors; overflow 0 at both classes after the min-width:0 grid fix; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the honesty probe and model-only branch on load, and on every batch asserts the filtering invariant (delivered === source-match under SSM, all delivered under ASM) with the full result set attached — a wrong model would fail telemetry.

design_system.rationale: Tokens only; delivered/filtered use emerald/rose on ivory (emerald-dark for text); the MODEL tag is black-on-ivory inverse; preset buttons and the send button pair background with color.

accessibility.rationale: The SVG is aria-hidden with a complete text equivalent (aria-live summary, semantic ledger table, labelled reversed log list); controls are native inputs in fieldsets with a labelled select and 44px targets.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: SVG scales via viewBox at width:100%, labels wrap, ledger scrolls in its wrapper; measured overflow 0 at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800 after adding min-width:0 to the stage grid items; both screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Pair the lab with a live IWA sample doing a real SSM join
openQuestions.detail: The lab is necessarily a model on a showcase page. A companion installable IWA sample (signed bundle + direct-sockets-multicast policy + the SourceSpecificMulticastInDirectSockets flag) that performs the same 232.1.1.1/192.0.2.100 join against a local sender would turn the model's claims into recorded packet evidence; link it from this page when it exists.

openQuestions.title: Diagram packet animation relies on CSS transforms
openQuestions.detail: The outcome markers and ledger render synchronously so reduced-motion or screenshot contexts lose nothing, but consider honoring prefers-reduced-motion by skipping the dot transition entirely.

guidanceConsulted.query: svg diagram accessibility interactive visualization text alternative
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Hide decorative/duplicative graphics from the accessibility tree and provide an equivalent text rendering of the same state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The network SVG is aria-hidden; the identical information lands in the aria-live summary, the ledger table, and the event log on every send.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel layout without horizontal overflow on narrow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Set min-width:0 on grid items so wide pre/code content cannot blow out the column.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied .stage > * { min-width: 0 } after the 360px matrix measured 233px overflow from the call/joinedGroups pre blocks; re-measured 0.

guidanceConsulted.query: native checkboxes and radios themed to the design system
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Theme native controls with accent-color rather than custom replacements.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Mode radios, sender checkboxes and the source select are native controls with accent-color: var(--accent-blue).

summary: Configurator + scenarios concept: the exact SSM/ASM join calls built interactively, filtering behavior modelled per spec with a per-sender ledger and attacker preset, everything labelled MODEL with a live honesty probe — and the practical explainer scenarios (video wall, discovery) carried as presets.
